subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with detail-bearing contexts be suppressed before mutating handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests and recent warning-path work preserve visible exec details in several contexts, so automation cannot safely choose a suppress-all policy and rewrite tests without maintainer intent.

options.title: Clarify And Rework Policy
options.body: Confirm the intended exec-like warning exceptions, then update the branch ordering and regression tests before merge.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Warnings
options.body: Narrow or close the linked issue if maintainers decide cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, or mutating exec failures should continue warning.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until the contributor adds proof and the policy direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Rework Policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended exec-like warning exceptions, then update the branch ordering and regression tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this handle to the tool mutation and warning-policy surfaces that determine the branch order.
